text.insert: The migration map records each legacy source’s final disposition and its route into the knowledge system. The table is canonical; the canvas and outline describe the one backfill pipeline shared by every retained input.

props.title: Final source dispositions
rows: Authored standards remain authoritative; rejected patterns become linked examples.
Records become standard examples or tombstones; the standalone source is removed.
Evidence-backed facts become learnings; path resolution moves to the crosswalk.
No seed import because its blurbs lack durable evidence references.
The file mirror remains directly searchable; crosswalk pointers locate relevant titles.
Typed PR intake feeds attempts and learnings through the librarian.
Epoch-derived index follows the shared extractor-to-JSONL-to-graph pattern.
Adds asm-derived CALLS and REFERENCES_DATA plus other per-target edges.
Raw timestamped messages are primary input; the markdown distillate is a cross-check corpus.
Remain parked and unavailable to workers.
One librarian absorbs their duties as typed doors.
Unused worker corpus is removed from active surfaces.

text.insert: Backfill and live intake use the same librarian and publication rules. Backfill changes only the source range: each statement is anchored against the current checkout before chronology resolves supersession.

props.title: Two ranges, one pipeline
rows: Evidence timestamps resolve supersession; failed anchors become historical context or are dropped.
Worker completion, new PR, or Discord sync
New evidence corroborates or refutes existing learnings.

steps.text: pull typed source items with stable evidence and timestamps
extract candidate attempts and learnings through the librarian
validate content hashes and symbol anchors against the current checkout
publish anchored records; retain useful historical context for failed anchors
resolve contradictions by evidence and timestamp while retaining refuted evidence
rebuild search and target links after the apply wave
